question: Approve the ideation direction: retire the legacy TeamCreate surface, keep and xfail-bind selected-team, and ship the unbound template-slot fix as the root cause?

artifacts.summary: Ideation refuted the filing's central premise. The live proof does NOT demand a team_name — its oracle requires team_name ABSENT (dispatch_recovery_assert_test.go:181). The CI red's only failing predicate was subagent_type="", traced to an unbound {dispatch_agent_id} slot in the break-glass manual template: a real product gap, not a stale test. Retirement settled as fact — no supported host can consume the legacy envelope since TeamCreate is absent from the merged CI floor (#390, build.go:338) — so the binary, help text, and commission surfaces are leftovers. Recommends KEEP selected-team, register it under the existing sonnet-flake owner, and ship the slot binding. reconcile --team-name classified keep: auto-team identity, not the legacy envelope. Surface: net -500 across ~48 files (+120/-620), product -180 / tests -320 / docs 0, tolerance net [-250,-750], files ≤60.
